title: Unveiling the 2D/2D hybrid of MXene anchored on g-C3N5 nanosheets for enhanced photo-Fenton-like removal of tetracycline and electrocatalytic water splitting performance
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2026, 13,2774-2794
DOI: 10.1039/D6EN00119J, Paper
Kabir Hussain Badagoppam Haroon, Sathish Rajendran, Veerappan Kavinkumar, A.R. Pavithraa, Vijay Sithaiyan, Nandhakumar Eswaramoorthy, Kandasamy Jothivenkatachalam, Susanta Kumar Bhunia
A binary Ti3C2/g-C3N5 (MXCN) heterojunction has been reported for the degradation of tetracycline antibiotics through photocatalytic reactions and electrocatalytic water splitting.
